verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM advertises 'Dynamic Model Selection' and lets users 'swap models' plus supports multiple LLM/embedder providers (confirmed by community reports of using both local Ollama and cloud APIs like GPT-4o), which supports the multi-provider claim. However, the evidence never explicitly documents per-agent or per-conversation model switching granularity, nor a full list of supported providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter) beyond general mentions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-conversation/per-agent model overrides, a concrete provider list confirming Anthropic/Google/OpenRouter support, and independent hands-on confirmation of switching mid-conversation.
